latvia.title: Letartóztattak egy férfit, aki a Bécs felé tartó vonaton rátámadt a jegyvizsgálóra
latvia.description: Minden előjel nélkül nekiment a kalauznak, többször megütötte, majd halálosan megfenyegette.

latvia.title: Élet Káel után: kiírták a pályázatot a Nemzeti Filmintézet elnök-vezérigazgatói posztjára
latvia.description: 5 év szakmai tapasztalat, 5 év vezetői gyakorlat, nemzetközi szakmai kapcsolatok – akinek mindez megvan, pályázhat.

latvia.title: Gázolt a vonat Szőlősnyaralónál, késésekre kell számítani
latvia.description: Sülysáp és Tápiószecső között csak egy vágányon haladnak a vonatok.

latvia.title: Kiírták a pályázatot a Nemzeti Filmintézet elnök-vezérigazgatói posztjára
latvia.description: A benyújtási határidő 2026. szeptember 14.

latvia.title: Először kapott magyar parancsnokot a NATO egyik szervezete
latvia.description: Antal László vezérőrnagy vezeti a NATO Közép-európai Többnemzeti Hadosztály-parancsnokságot.

latvia.title: Vadászgépeket riasztottak Oroszország miatt: veszélyes rakéta csapódott be Ukrajna szomszédjánál
latvia.description: A lengyel légierő F-16-os vadászgépei ismét elfogtak egy orosz Il-20-as felderítő repülőgépet a Balti-tenger felett, amely kikapcsolt transzponderrel és repülési terv nélkül közlekedett – jelentette be Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz védelmi miniszter. Eközben a lublini ügyészség hivatalosan is megerősítette, hogy a csütörtökön Lengyelország keleti részén becsapódott eszköz egy orosz gyártmányú Kh-101-es cirkálórakéta volt, amelyet 2026 második negyedévében állítottak elő. A rakéta hajnalban lépett be a lengyel légtérbe, és egy lakatlan területen csapódott földbe; az elfogására riasztott vadászgépek radarképernyőjéről a célpont rövid időn belül eltűnt. Az incidens nyomán a NATO és Lengyelország is aktiválta védelmi rendszereit, az ügyben pedig a lublini ügyészség katonai osztálya indított nyomozást.

latvia.title: Orosz rakéta törte át a NATO határát, miközben F-16-osok védték a légteret - Ez mégis hogy történhetett meg?
latvia.description: Lengyelország nyilvánosságra hozta, miért nem tudta lelőni azt az orosz H–101-es cirkálórakétát, amely mintegy 100 kilométert repült az ország légterében, mielőtt a lublini térségben becsapódott. A vizsgálat megállapítása szerint a jogszabályi előírások által megkövetelt vizuális célazonosítás jelentette a fő akadályt.

latvia.title: Orosz rakéta tört be a NATO területére, súlyos támadás érte az ukrán hadiipart – Ukrajnai háborús híreink csütörtökön
latvia.description: Kiadta a legfrissebb jelentését az ukrán légierő, ebben pontosan részletezik a július 30-i orosz támadást – számolt be az Ukrajinszka Pravda. A nagyszabású orosz támadás során rengeteg, különböző típusú rakétát vetettek be, ezek Ukrajna jelentős részén komoly károkat okoztak. Az egyik eszköz a szomszédos Lengyelországot is elérte – számolt be az RBK Ukraine. Ott hajnalban riasztást kellett kiadni, ennek következtében az F-16-os vadászgépek is a levegőbe emelkedtek – közölte a TVP World. Később az orosz hatóságok megnevezték a ma hajnali támadás célpontjait, állításuk szerint nagyon súlyos csapásokat szenvedett el Ukrajna – közölte a Ria Novosztyi. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legfrissebb eseményeivel.

latvia.title: Egy hétbe is beletelhet a paksi atomerőmű teljes újraindítása
latvia.description: A 2026. július végi tájékoztatás szerint, bár a Paksi Atomerőműben egy-egy blokk leállítása viszonylag gyorsan elvégezhető, ha mind a négy reaktor hetekre leáll, működő egység hiányában akár egy hétig is eltarthat az újraindítási folyamat – közölte az intézmény műszaki vezérigazgató-helyettese az MTI érdeklődésére.

latvia.title: Felmentések sora a Külügyminisztériumban: visszahívják a washingtoni, moszkvai és londoni nagyköveteket is
latvia.description: Összesen 25 nagykövet külképviselet-vezetői megbízatásának megszüntetését hirdették ki a pénteki Magyar Közlönyben. A legnagyobb külpolitikai súlyú érintett állomáshelyek között van Washington, ahonnan Takács Szabolcs Ferenc, Moszkva, ahonnan Konkoly Norbert Attila, London, ahonnan Kumin Ferenc, valamint Kijev, ahonnan Heizer Antal távozik. Váltás lesz továbbá a belgrádi, a pozsonyi és a prágai nagykövetségen, illetve Magyarország NATO-, ENSZ-, EBESZ- és WTO-képviseleteinek élén is.

latvia.title: Trump: Ukraina nie ma naszej zgody
latvia.description: Stany Zjednoczone nie zgodziły się na udzielenie Ukrainie licencji na produkcję systemów rakietowych Patriot - przekazał w piątek prezydent USA Donald Trump. Jego słowa padły trzy dni po spotkaniu w Białym Domu z prezydentem Ukrainy Wołodymyrem Zełenskim, który ocenił rozmowy jako "dobre".

latvia.title: Pápež Lev XIV. mení pravidlá Vatikánu. Nová ústava ruší podmienku kardinála na čele governatorátu
latvia.description: Pápež Lev XIV. mení pravidlá fungovania Vatikánu novou ústavou. Dokument otvára priestor pre širšie vedenie štátu a reaguje na aktuálne výzvy.

latvia.title: Škandál v Bruseli: Zadržaná stážistka z centrály NATO údajne pracovala pre Čínu
latvia.description: Kanadská stážistka v NATO, ktorú belgické úrady minulý piatok zadržali pre podozrenie zo špionáže, pracovala pre Čínu. S odvolaním sa na svoje zdroje o tom v piatok informovala agentúra Reuters.

latvia.title: Zadržená stážistka v NATO pracovala pro Čínu, píše Reuters
latvia.description: Kanadská stážistka v NATO, kterou belgické úřady minulý pátek zadržely kvůli podezření ze špionáže, pracovala pro Čínu. Ve čtvrtek to s odvoláním na své zdroje napsala agentura Reuters. Belgická prokuratura, kanadské úřady ani orgány Severoatlantické aliance dosud neupřesnily, pro koho špionáž prováděla. Ve sdělení prokuratury se nicméně uvádí, že žena je kanadskou občankou čínského původu.

latvia.title: Tentativă de asasinat orchestrată de serviciile ruse: cum a fost vizat comandantul unei brigăzi ucrainene. Anunțul lui Zelenski
latvia.description: Ihor Obolenski, comandantul Brigăzii Khartia din Ucraina, a fost victima unei tentative de asasinat, a anunțat președintele ucrainean Volodimir Zelenski. El a adăugat că un suspect în acest caz a fost arestat.

latvia.title: NATO ia în calcul consolidarea descurajării nucleare în Europa. Ce țări ar putea fi vizate pentru desfășurarea de noi rachete americane
latvia.description: NATO intenţionează să-şi extindă descurajarea nucleară în Europa în lumina ameninţărilor din partea preşedintelui rus Vladimir Putin, potrivit unor informaţii obţinute de dpa.

latvia.title: NATO își întărește flancul estic. Spania a trimis avioane F-18 și elicoptere în România. MApN: 7 aeronave au sosit la Baza 86 Borcea
latvia.description: Spania desfășoară la baza aeriană Mihail Kogălniceanu avioane de luptă F-18, un avion cisternă, elicoptere pentru cobaterea dronelor şi aproximativ 200 de militari, conform unui anunţ al NATO, care precizează că Forţele Aeriene ale Italiei, Spaniei şi Turciei îşi vor trimite avioanele de luptă pentru a contribui la securitatea spaţiului aerian al NATO de pe Flancul Estic, în cadrul noii misiuni de Apărare Aeriană a Alianţei.

latvia.title: Kasparov avertizează că estul NATO ar putea fi următorul pus la încercare de Rusia. „Putin are nevoie de o narațiune victorioasă”
latvia.description: Președintele rus Vladimir Putin ar putea încerca o incursiune limitată în Polonia sau în țările baltice, deoarece are nevoie de o „narațiune victorioasă” pe care războiul din Ucraina nu a reușit să i-o ofere până acum, a avertizat Garry Kasparov, critic al Kremlinului și legendă a șahului mondial. Kasparov a declarat pentru TVP World că riscul ca Rusia să treacă granița de est a NATO este în creștere, dacă Europa nu acționează decisiv, avertizând că chiar și o operațiune de mică amploare cu drone i-ar putea permite lui Putin să afirme că alianța nu mai este capabilă să-și apere membrii.

latvia.title: Debitul Dunării scade dramatic și se apropie de recordul negativ din 1985. Ce măsuri sunt în vigoare pentru irigații
latvia.description: România traversează una dintre cele mai dificile perioade hidrologice din ultimele decenii, în condițiile în care nici în bazinul superior al Dunării nu sunt prognozate precipitații în perioada imediat următoare, potrivit Administrației Naționale „Apele Române”.

latvia.title: Cancelarul Merz trage un semnal de alarmă după ce o rachetă rusească s-a prăbușit pe teritoriul NATO
latvia.description: Pătrunderea unei rachete în spaţiul aerian polonez şi căderea acesteia în estul Poloniei, în timpul unui atac aerian rusesc masiv asupra Ucrainei, demonstrează „lipsa completă de scrupule a Rusiei” şi faptul că Moscova este „pregătită de o escaladare” a tensiunilor cu Europa, a declarat joi cancelarul german Friedrich Merz, relatează AFP şi Reuters.

latvia.title: Stagiara acuzată de spionaj la NATO a lucrat și în alte instituții publice importante din Europa și Canada
latvia.description: Nu e prima ei încercare? Firească întrebarea, căci profilul stagiarei acuzată de spionaj la NATO devine din ce în ce mai interesant. Canadiana de origine chineză suspectată de spionaj în timpul stagiului său la SHAPE din Mons a lucrat pentru mai multe instituții publice, după cum relevă o anchetă realizată de CBC News. Această femeie, Claire Biwei Zhang, are un CV impresionant, care include atât Agenția Spațială Europeană, cât și Organizația Mondială a Comerțului din Elveția, scrie 7sur7.be.

latvia.title: NATO trimite în România avioane F-18 din Spania, elicoptere anti-dronă și 200 de militari iberici
latvia.description: România va putea să doboare din elicopter dronele care intră pe teritoriul țării. NATO trimite șapte avioane de vânătoare F-18, trei elicoptere echipate antidronă și o aeronavă de realimentare în aer.

latvia.title: CSM îi ia apărarea lui Marius Voineag, după jignirile aduse de Cristian Ghinea: Depășește cu mult libertatea de exprimare
latvia.description: Consiliul Superior al Magistraturii, prin intermediul Secției pentru procurori, a intervenit pentru apărarea reputației profesionale a actualului adjunct al procurorului general, Marius Voineag, fostul șef al Direcției Naționale Anticorupție (DNA), pe fondul unei jigniri adresate de senatorul USR, Cristian Ghinea.

latvia.title: NATO confirmă că obiectul prăbușit în estul Poloniei este „o rachetă rusească de tip necunoscut”
latvia.description: Autoritățile poloneze investighează un loc al prăbușirii unui rachete rusești, în estul țării, în contextul în care avioane de vânătoare au fost mobilizate în noaptea de miercuri spre joi, ca răspuns la intensificarea activității militare a Rusiei în apropierea graniței cu Ucraina, informează TVP World.

latvia.title: Momentul în care un avion de vânătoare F-35 se prăbușește lângă baza militară devenită faimoasă cu filmul „Top Gun”
latvia.description: Un avion de vânătoare „stealth” F-35 al armatei SUA s-a prăbușit vineri dimineață în apropierea unei baze militare din San Diego, în sudul Californiei, au anunțat autoritățile americane, potrivit AFP. „Un incident aerian în care a fost implicat un avion F-35 Bravo al Corpului de Marină a avut loc în apropierea bazei aeriene MCAS Miramar”, …

latvia.title: Aeronavă rusească de spionaj IL-20, interceptată de două avioane de vânătoare poloneze F-16. „Fără plan de zbor și cu transponderul oprit”
latvia.description: Forțele aeriene poloneze au interceptat din nou un avion de recunoaștere rusesc deasupra Mării Baltice, a anunțat vineri guvernul de la Varșovia, care a publicat noi detalii în legătură cu prăbușirea unei rachete rusești pe teritoriul polonez cu o zi înainte, informează agenția germană de presă DPA. Două avioane de vânătoare poloneze F-16 au fost …

latvia.title: Finland to work with Estonia to stop migrants, interior minister says
latvia.description: Interior Minister Igor Taro (Eesti 200) said the Finnish authorities will assist their Estonian counterparts in stopping illegal immigrants who are trying to reach the Nordics after crossing the Belarusian-Latvian border.

latvia.title: Estonia still waiting for Latvia's official position on Rail Baltica's future
latvia.description: Estonia is still waiting for the new Latvian government's official position on the Rail Baltica project and whether Riga has plans to change its railway construction plans.

latvia.title: Police find €3,000 in cash in pockets of suspected money mule
latvia.description: Officers from the Northern Prefecture detained a 37‑year‑old Latvian resident in Tallinn on Monday, discovering €3,000 in cash in his pockets. Police believe he acted as a money mule in a series of fraud cases.

latvia.title: 63 migrants from Belarus caught in Estonia last week and more expected, PPA says
latvia.description: Over the past week, 63 migrants with no legal right to be in Estonia have been caught by the police – almost double the number apprehended last year. The authorities say the situation is connected to the migration pressure on the Latvian-Belarus border and will likely continue until the weather worsens.

latvia.title: Minister: Estonia sends extra border guards to Latvia as Belarus drives migrant surge
latvia.description: Estonia will send additional police and border guard forces to Latvia to strengthen the European Union's external border. The decision came after several dozen illegal migrants who entered the country through Belarus and Latvia were detained in Estonia in recent days.

latvia.title: BLOGI ⟩ 1620. sõjapäev Ukrainas: Kiievis avaldati taas meelt ekskaitseminister Fedorovi ametisse ennistamise toetuseks
latvia.description: 2022. aasta 24. veebruaril alustas Venemaa režiimi juht Vladimir Putin sissetungi Ukrainasse. Pärast seda, kui Ukraina lõi tagasi pealetungi Kiievile, on lahingute kese kandunud Ida- ja Lõuna-Ukrainasse. Postimees kajastab 1620. sõjapäeva sündmusi allolevas blogis.

latvia.title: Kiievis avaldati taas meelt ekskaitseminister Fedorovi ametisse ennistamise toetuseks
latvia.description: Tuhanded inimesed avaldasid eile Ukraina pealinnas Kiievis meelt, et nõuda kaks nädalat tagasi tagandatud noore ja tehnikateadliku kaitseministri Mõhhailo Fedorovi ametisse ennistamist.

latvia.title: NÄDALA NÄGU ⟩ Omakasupüüdlik rahutuvi Putini kõrva ääres
latvia.description: Kasahstani presidendi Kassõm-Džomart Tokajevi Vene režiimi juhile Vladimir Putinile silmast silma esitatud üleskutset peatada võitlus Ukrainas on küll tõlgendatud kui Kremli liitlase üllatavat kriitikat, kuid nii mõnedki piirkonda hästi tundvad analüütikud on seadnud kahtluse alla mõtteavalduse spontaansuse.

latvia.title: GALERII ⟩ Vaata, kuidas Scorpions raputas rahva läbi nagu orkaan
latvia.description: Legendaarne Saksa rocki suurkuju Scorpions tähistab erakordse tuuriga 60 aasta pikkust karjääri ja naasis selle tähistamiseks sel suvel Eestisse, andes Balti riikide ainsa suurejoonelise kontserdi 31. juulil Unibet Arena Kvartalis.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 31st July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvia-Belarus border closed due to 'technical reasons'
latvia.description: For ''technical reasons'', the Latvian-Belarusian border has been closed, as announced by the Minister for the Interior, Jānis Dombrava (National Alliance), on his social media accounts.

latvia.title: Latvia's anti-corruption chief quits early
latvia.description: The head of Latvia's dedicated ani-graft agency, the Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB), Jēkabs Straume, has announced his surprise retirement just one year before the end of his second term.

latvia.title: Jelgava is hot on Friday
latvia.description: On Friday, by 3 pm, the air temperature at the Jelgava weather station in Staļģene reached +31.8 degrees, breaking the heat record for the last day of July.

latvia.title: International drone defence exercise to take place in Latvia
latvia.description: From August 3rd to 14th, the military exercise “Baltic Trust 26” (BATT26), jointly organized by the Latvian National Armed Forces (NBS) and the NATO Communications and Information Agency, will be held at Sēlija military range in southern Latvia.

latvia.title: Estonia frustrated by Latvia's dithering on Rail Baltica
latvia.description: Latvia's intentions with regard to the troubled Rail Baltica infrastructure project remain a mystery to the other countries involved in building it, reports Estonia's ERR News.

latvia.title: Business mood improved in Latvia in July
latvia.description: Data published on July 31st shows some cautiously encouraging confidence in the Latvian business world.

latvia.title: New zebra crossings to be set up in Rīga
latvia.description: In order to improve the safety of pedestrians, Rīga municipality plans to install new pedestrian crossings in several places in the city. The works are scheduled to be completed by September 5.

latvia.title: Latvia's Baltic coastline battles Soviet and modern trash
latvia.description: This summer, a battle has been taking place on the picturesque Jūrkalne cliffs against waste dumped by the Soviet army.

latvia.title: Swimming not recommended in Saldus Lake in Latvia
latvia.description: The Health Inspectorate issued a recommendation on 31 July that it is not advised to swim at Saldus Lake at the moment.

latvia.title: Sārts sounds warning on potential election disruption efforts
latvia.description: Jānis Sārts, the director of the Rīga-based NATO Strategic Communications Centre of Excellence (STRATCOMCOE) said in an interview with Latvian Radio on July 31st that Latvia's upcoming parliamentary elections could face various challenges and attempts to influence and disrupt them, with threats including drone incursions, cyberattacks and the use of malicious Artificial Intelligence (AI).

latvia.title: Friday will be hottest day of week in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that Friday will be the hottest day of the week.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: festival summer continues
latvia.description: This weekend could be perfect for festivals – just take your pick.

latvia.title: More espionage cases seen in Latvian courts
latvia.description: A financier who collaborated with the pro-Kremlin organisation “Baltic Anti-Fascists” appeared in court on Thursday. Jevgenijs Okss gathered information in Russia’s interests about two people living in Latvia; he also met with a representative of the Russian Federal Security Service in Moscow, Latvian Television reported on July 30.

latvia.title: Latvian pilot sets world record in model aircraft flight
latvia.description: The World Air Sports Federation (FAI) has officially recognised the first world record achieved by Latvian model aircraft pilot Viktors Rošonoks in the history of Latvian model aircraft sport, the Latvian Model Aircraft Sports Federation (LLSF) said on Thursday.

latvia.title: Liepāja to see new murals
latvia.description: Every year, Liepāja’s landscape is enriched by large-scale murals created by both local and international artists. Three works are currently being created by artists from Spain, Mexico and France, TV Kurzeme reported on July 30.

latvia.title: Distinguished historian Vestermanis dies aged 100
latvia.description: The eminent historian, founder and long-time director of the 'Jews in Latvia' museum, Marģers Vestermanis, has died, the museum has announced.

latvia.title: A quarter of Latvians can't afford a week's holiday away
latvia.description: In 2025, 27.5% of the EU’s population aged 16 or older were unable to afford one week of annual holidays away from home, according to Eurostat data published on July 30th.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 30th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.description: On July 30th, Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) chaired a closed extraordinary meeting of the Cabinet of Ministers (in the 'Secure Negotiations Room') at the main government building in Rīga.

latvia.title: Livonian festival taking place this weekend
latvia.description: At the end of July, you can go to Latvia's western Kurzeme region not only to sunbathe, but also to get to know and celebrate the region's Livonian heritage.

latvia.title: Economics Minister proposes banning overcrowded living among foreigners
latvia.description: The Minister for Economic Affairs, Viktors Valainis (Greens and Farmers Union), has approached the Saeima’s Committee on Defence, Home Affairs and Corruption Prevention with a call to launch a discussion on a new mechanism for immigration controls, the Economics Ministry said in a release on July 30.

latvia.title: Latvian climber who survived fall on Denali returns to Rīga
latvia.description: On the evening of Tuesday, 28 July, Mārtiņš Bilzēns, a member of the Latvian mountaineering group who had been seriously injured, returned to Latvia from Alaska.

latvia.title: Rīga's parks to host musical performances throughout August
latvia.description: This year, Riga will be celebrating its 825th anniversary, and everyone is invited to attend the wide-ranging festive events. Throughout August, the capital’s evenings will be filled with music from the park concert series at the Dzegužkalns Open-Air Stage, Ziemeļblāzma Palace Park and Vērmane Garden.

latvia.title: Off-duty police officer drives drunk, crashes, flees scene
latvia.description: On Wednesday evening, the State Police in Aizkraukle arrested an off-duty police officer – a senior inspector – who, whilst under the influence of alcohol with a blood alcohol level of 3.18 per mille, caused a road traffic accident and subsequently fled the scene, the State Police reported.

latvia.title: Latvia's power distribution network to expand further
latvia.description: The state-owned company AS ‘Sadales tīkls’ (ST) will build two new substations in Saulkrasti and Saldus, as well as modernise the existing infrastructure in Salacgrīva, thereby enabling new electricity producers and consumers to be connected to the grid, the company announced on July 30.

latvia.title: Does the Saeima provide good value for money?
latvia.description: In the pre-election period it is perhaps not surprising that many politicians are trying to polish their credentials as money-managers, calling for controlled spending, probes in NGO funding, a review of scientific research costs and various other fiscal discipline measures.

latvia.title: Latvia's Interior Minister calls for investigation of police chief
latvia.description: Minister for the Interior Jānis Dombrava (National Alliance) is set to call for an internal investigation into State Police (VP) Chief Armands Ruks in connection with "various systematic breaches" in the State Police’s operations, including an incident in Priekule where a drunk police officer killed a man, notably whilst off duty.

latvia.title: 'Horos' contemporary dance festival comes to Rīga
latvia.description: On July 30th and 31st, Rīga will host the contemporary dance festival "Horos", which has moved from Aizpute to the capital for the first time.

latvia.title: Liepāja street upgrades set to continue
latvia.description: The road surfacing programme will continue in Liepāja until 2030, reports Latvian Radio, though not everyone is happy with the results so far.

latvia.title: Causes of Pitbull show cancellation to be investigated
latvia.description: There will be no new Pitbull concert in the near future, Ģirts Majors, head of the concert organiser “Positivus Music”, said on the Latvian Television programme “Morning Panorama” on July 30.

latvia.title: Latvia will get hotter on Thursday
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that the weather in Latvia will become hotter on Thursday.

latvia.title: Balticovo builds flats for employees in Iecava, Latvia
latvia.description: The poultry farming company AS ‘Balticovo’ has invested more than two million euros in a staff apartment block project in Iecava, the company announced on July 29.

latvia.title: Roadworks in central Rīga set to begin
latvia.description: Construction of the cycle path along 11 November Embankment will begin with the section from Akmens Bridge to Dzelzceļa Bridge, where the first construction works are due to start in August. Meanwhile, on Ģertrūdes Street, the section from Aleksandra Čaka Street to Krišjāņa Barona Street will be renovated, Rīga City Council said.

latvia.title: Security guard appears in Latvian court on suspicion of spying for Russia
latvia.description: On July 29th a former store security guard was led into a Rīga court in handcuffs, accused not only of espionage, but also of hooliganism and robbery.

latvia.title: Police: Unauthorised gathering is illegal, Pitbull-themed or not
latvia.description: Following the cancellation of singer Pitbull’s concert, which was due to take place on 29 July at the Mežaparks Grand Open-Air Stage, calls have been made on social media and other online platforms for people to gather at the planned concert venue nonetheless. The State Police point out that such calls are unlawful.

latvia.title: Estonia sending more border guards to help Latvia
latvia.description: Estonian public media ERR News reports that Estonia will send additional police and border guard forces to Latvia to strengthen the European Union's external border.

latvia.title: Dementia a bigger problem in Latvia than figures suggest
latvia.description: In Latvia, just over 5,000 people have been officially diagnosed with dementia, but using internationally recognized methodology, it is estimated that the real number with the condition could reach as many as 38,000 [Data from the non-governmental organization “Alzheimer Europe”] according to a release from the Society Integration Fund (SIF).

latvia.title: Latvia's retail sector enjoyed a strong June
latvia.description: Calendar adjusted data (at constant prices) compiled by the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) and published on July 29th show that, compared to June 2025, in June 2026 Latvia's total retail trade turnover rose by 4.8 %.

latvia.title: Rīga's hotels also affected by cancelled Pitbull show
latvia.description: Just one day before the event, the concert by American musician Pitbull in Mežaparks has been cancelled. The hospitality sector is also already facing cancellations of bookings, whilst the Consumer Rights Protection Centre will be monitoring the situation to ensure that consumer rights are upheld, namely that the money spent on tickets is refunded, Latvan Radio reported on July 29.

latvia.title: Forum Cinemas to take over Cinamon in Rīga
latvia.description: The Competition Council (KP) has authorised the subsidiary of “Forum Cinemas Latvia OU” (Forum Cinemas) to acquire the lease rights to premises adapted for cinema use in the ‘Akropole Alfa’ shopping centre, where SIA ‘Cinamon Operations Latvia’ (‘Cinamon’) currently operates, the KP announced Wednesday.

latvia.title: Latvia-Ukraine driving licence parity coming in September
latvia.description: From September 2nd, 2026, an agreement between Latvia and Ukraine on the mutual recognition and exchange of driving licences will enter into force, which will allow nationals of both countries to exchange driving licences issued in their own country for a driving licence of the other country without the need to take a test.

latvia.title: Over 100 drug hiding spots found in criminal case in Latvia
latvia.description: Following the admission of a young woman to Kuldīga Hospital last September after suffering drug poisoning, the State Police arrested a man and launched an investigation, during which they discovered more than 100 drug dens in the forests around Jelgava and Jūrmala. The criminal case has been referred to the Prosecutor’s Office, the State Police reported.

latvia.title: Booze sales restrictions have not changed consumption much in Latvia
latvia.description: The restrictions on the sale of alcoholic beverages, introduced a year ago, have not significantly reduced alcohol purchases, but have changed shoppers’ buying habits, with people adjusting the times at which they shop, according to retailers surveyed by the LETA news agency on July 29.

latvia.title: New industrial park planned for Rēzekne
latvia.description: A new industrial park is being planned north of Rēzekne in eastern Latvia which should be one of the most significant city development projects in the coming years.

latvia.title: Any Russian 'little green men' will be neutralised, says Latvian Defence Minister
latvia.description: Currently, a direct military, conventional Russian attack on NATO is not possible, and stating this is not just an attempt to calm public fears of conflict, Latvian Defence Minister Raivis Melnis said in an interview with the LETA newswire.

latvia.title: Latvian police forces could introduce daily alcohol testing
latvia.description: Following the tragedy in Priekule, the State Police might introduce alcohol tests at the start of the working day as a preventative measure, particularly for officers who carry a weapon or drive a service vehicle, Interior Minister Jānis Dombrava (National Alliance) said in an interview with Latvian Radio on July 29.

latvia.title: Ukrainian aid organisation continues work after warehouse fire
latvia.description: The “Tavi draugi” association is continuing its work, despite a potentially malicious fire last week in which a large proportion of the aid intended for Ukrainians was destroyed. Several businesspeople have offered the association premises, and the local council is also considering options. However, for the time being, volunteers are carrying on with their work in temporary tents, Latvian Television reported on July 28.

latvia.title: Latvia's eastern border to be reinforced until end of 2027
latvia.description: On Tuesday, the Government took note of a report from the Ministry of the Interior on the construction of infrastructure along the country’s eastern border. Work is scheduled to be completed by the end of this year, although the State Real Estate (VNĪ) plans to continue work on certain sections until the end of next year, Latvian Radio reported July 28.

latvia.description: Vai atceries, kas notika ar Izauru? Kā klājās galvenajai varonei seriālā “Vienkārši Marija”? Un vai “Smalkais stils” bija kas vairāk par Burkā kundzi? lithuania.description: Minden előjel nélkül nekiment a kalauznak, többször megütötte, majd halálosan megfenyegette.

lithuania.description: Sülysáp és Tápiószecső között csak egy vágányon haladnak a vonatok.

lithuania.title: Először kapott magyar parancsnokot a NATO egyik szervezete
lithuania.description: Antal László vezérőrnagy vezeti a NATO Közép-európai Többnemzeti Hadosztály-parancsnokságot.

lithuania.title: Vadászgépeket riasztottak Oroszország miatt: veszélyes rakéta csapódott be Ukrajna szomszédjánál
lithuania.description: A lengyel légierő F-16-os vadászgépei ismét elfogtak egy orosz Il-20-as felderítő repülőgépet a Balti-tenger felett, amely kikapcsolt transzponderrel és repülési terv nélkül közlekedett – jelentette be Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz védelmi miniszter. Eközben a lublini ügyészség hivatalosan is megerősítette, hogy a csütörtökön Lengyelország keleti részén becsapódott eszköz egy orosz gyártmányú Kh-101-es cirkálórakéta volt, amelyet 2026 második negyedévében állítottak elő. A rakéta hajnalban lépett be a lengyel légtérbe, és egy lakatlan területen csapódott földbe; az elfogására riasztott vadászgépek radarképernyőjéről a célpont rövid időn belül eltűnt. Az incidens nyomán a NATO és Lengyelország is aktiválta védelmi rendszereit, az ügyben pedig a lublini ügyészség katonai osztálya indított nyomozást.

lithuania.title: Orosz rakéta törte át a NATO határát, miközben F-16-osok védték a légteret - Ez mégis hogy történhetett meg?
lithuania.description: Lengyelország nyilvánosságra hozta, miért nem tudta lelőni azt az orosz H–101-es cirkálórakétát, amely mintegy 100 kilométert repült az ország légterében, mielőtt a lublini térségben becsapódott. A vizsgálat megállapítása szerint a jogszabályi előírások által megkövetelt vizuális célazonosítás jelentette a fő akadályt.

lithuania.title: Orosz rakéta tört be a NATO területére, súlyos támadás érte az ukrán hadiipart – Ukrajnai háborús híreink csütörtökön
lithuania.description: Kiadta a legfrissebb jelentését az ukrán légierő, ebben pontosan részletezik a július 30-i orosz támadást – számolt be az Ukrajinszka Pravda. A nagyszabású orosz támadás során rengeteg, különböző típusú rakétát vetettek be, ezek Ukrajna jelentős részén komoly károkat okoztak. Az egyik eszköz a szomszédos Lengyelországot is elérte – számolt be az RBK Ukraine. Ott hajnalban riasztást kellett kiadni, ennek következtében az F-16-os vadászgépek is a levegőbe emelkedtek – közölte a TVP World. Később az orosz hatóságok megnevezték a ma hajnali támadás célpontjait, állításuk szerint nagyon súlyos csapásokat szenvedett el Ukrajna – közölte a Ria Novosztyi. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legfrissebb eseményeivel.

lithuania.title: Felmentések sora a Külügyminisztériumban: visszahívják a washingtoni, moszkvai és londoni nagyköveteket is
lithuania.description: Összesen 25 nagykövet külképviselet-vezetői megbízatásának megszüntetését hirdették ki a pénteki Magyar Közlönyben. A legnagyobb külpolitikai súlyú érintett állomáshelyek között van Washington, ahonnan Takács Szabolcs Ferenc, Moszkva, ahonnan Konkoly Norbert Attila, London, ahonnan Kumin Ferenc, valamint Kijev, ahonnan Heizer Antal távozik. Váltás lesz továbbá a belgrádi, a pozsonyi és a prágai nagykövetségen, illetve Magyarország NATO-, ENSZ-, EBESZ- és WTO-képviseleteinek élén is.

lithuania.title: Trump: Ukraina nie ma naszej zgody
lithuania.description: Stany Zjednoczone nie zgodziły się na udzielenie Ukrainie licencji na produkcję systemów rakietowych Patriot - przekazał w piątek prezydent USA Donald Trump. Jego słowa padły trzy dni po spotkaniu w Białym Domu z prezydentem Ukrainy Wołodymyrem Zełenskim, który ocenił rozmowy jako "dobre".

lithuania.title: Pápež Lev XIV. mení pravidlá Vatikánu. Nová ústava ruší podmienku kardinála na čele governatorátu
lithuania.description: Pápež Lev XIV. mení pravidlá fungovania Vatikánu novou ústavou. Dokument otvára priestor pre širšie vedenie štátu a reaguje na aktuálne výzvy.

lithuania.title: Škandál v Bruseli: Zadržaná stážistka z centrály NATO údajne pracovala pre Čínu
lithuania.description: Kanadská stážistka v NATO, ktorú belgické úrady minulý piatok zadržali pre podozrenie zo špionáže, pracovala pre Čínu. S odvolaním sa na svoje zdroje o tom v piatok informovala agentúra Reuters.

lithuania.title: Zadržená stážistka v NATO pracovala pro Čínu, píše Reuters
lithuania.description: Kanadská stážistka v NATO, kterou belgické úřady minulý pátek zadržely kvůli podezření ze špionáže, pracovala pro Čínu. Ve čtvrtek to s odvoláním na své zdroje napsala agentura Reuters. Belgická prokuratura, kanadské úřady ani orgány Severoatlantické aliance dosud neupřesnily, pro koho špionáž prováděla. Ve sdělení prokuratury se nicméně uvádí, že žena je kanadskou občankou čínského původu.

lithuania.title: NATO ia în calcul consolidarea descurajării nucleare în Europa. Ce țări ar putea fi vizate pentru desfășurarea de noi rachete americane
lithuania.description: NATO intenţionează să-şi extindă descurajarea nucleară în Europa în lumina ameninţărilor din partea preşedintelui rus Vladimir Putin, potrivit unor informaţii obţinute de dpa.

lithuania.title: NATO își întărește flancul estic. Spania a trimis avioane F-18 și elicoptere în România. MApN: 7 aeronave au sosit la Baza 86 Borcea
lithuania.description: Spania desfășoară la baza aeriană Mihail Kogălniceanu avioane de luptă F-18, un avion cisternă, elicoptere pentru cobaterea dronelor şi aproximativ 200 de militari, conform unui anunţ al NATO, care precizează că Forţele Aeriene ale Italiei, Spaniei şi Turciei îşi vor trimite avioanele de luptă pentru a contribui la securitatea spaţiului aerian al NATO de pe Flancul Estic, în cadrul noii misiuni de Apărare Aeriană a Alianţei.

lithuania.title: Kasparov avertizează că estul NATO ar putea fi următorul pus la încercare de Rusia. „Putin are nevoie de o narațiune victorioasă”
lithuania.description: Președintele rus Vladimir Putin ar putea încerca o incursiune limitată în Polonia sau în țările baltice, deoarece are nevoie de o „narațiune victorioasă” pe care războiul din Ucraina nu a reușit să i-o ofere până acum, a avertizat Garry Kasparov, critic al Kremlinului și legendă a șahului mondial. Kasparov a declarat pentru TVP World că riscul ca Rusia să treacă granița de est a NATO este în creștere, dacă Europa nu acționează decisiv, avertizând că chiar și o operațiune de mică amploare cu drone i-ar putea permite lui Putin să afirme că alianța nu mai este capabilă să-și apere membrii.

lithuania.title: Cancelarul Merz trage un semnal de alarmă după ce o rachetă rusească s-a prăbușit pe teritoriul NATO
lithuania.description: Pătrunderea unei rachete în spaţiul aerian polonez şi căderea acesteia în estul Poloniei, în timpul unui atac aerian rusesc masiv asupra Ucrainei, demonstrează „lipsa completă de scrupule a Rusiei” şi faptul că Moscova este „pregătită de o escaladare” a tensiunilor cu Europa, a declarat joi cancelarul german Friedrich Merz, relatează AFP şi Reuters.

lithuania.title: Stagiara acuzată de spionaj la NATO a lucrat și în alte instituții publice importante din Europa și Canada
lithuania.description: Nu e prima ei încercare? Firească întrebarea, căci profilul stagiarei acuzată de spionaj la NATO devine din ce în ce mai interesant. Canadiana de origine chineză suspectată de spionaj în timpul stagiului său la SHAPE din Mons a lucrat pentru mai multe instituții publice, după cum relevă o anchetă realizată de CBC News. Această femeie, Claire Biwei Zhang, are un CV impresionant, care include atât Agenția Spațială Europeană, cât și Organizația Mondială a Comerțului din Elveția, scrie 7sur7.be.

lithuania.title: NATO trimite în România avioane F-18 din Spania, elicoptere anti-dronă și 200 de militari iberici
lithuania.description: România va putea să doboare din elicopter dronele care intră pe teritoriul țării. NATO trimite șapte avioane de vânătoare F-18, trei elicoptere echipate antidronă și o aeronavă de realimentare în aer.

lithuania.title: CSM îi ia apărarea lui Marius Voineag, după jignirile aduse de Cristian Ghinea: Depășește cu mult libertatea de exprimare
lithuania.description: Consiliul Superior al Magistraturii, prin intermediul Secției pentru procurori, a intervenit pentru apărarea reputației profesionale a actualului adjunct al procurorului general, Marius Voineag, fostul șef al Direcției Naționale Anticorupție (DNA), pe fondul unei jigniri adresate de senatorul USR, Cristian Ghinea.

lithuania.title: NATO confirmă că obiectul prăbușit în estul Poloniei este „o rachetă rusească de tip necunoscut”
lithuania.description: Autoritățile poloneze investighează un loc al prăbușirii unui rachete rusești, în estul țării, în contextul în care avioane de vânătoare au fost mobilizate în noaptea de miercuri spre joi, ca răspuns la intensificarea activității militare a Rusiei în apropierea graniței cu Ucraina, informează TVP World.

lithuania.title: Momentul în care un avion de vânătoare F-35 se prăbușește lângă baza militară devenită faimoasă cu filmul „Top Gun”
lithuania.description: Un avion de vânătoare „stealth” F-35 al armatei SUA s-a prăbușit vineri dimineață în apropierea unei baze militare din San Diego, în sudul Californiei, au anunțat autoritățile americane, potrivit AFP. „Un incident aerian în care a fost implicat un avion F-35 Bravo al Corpului de Marină a avut loc în apropierea bazei aeriene MCAS Miramar”, …

lithuania.title: Aeronavă rusească de spionaj IL-20, interceptată de două avioane de vânătoare poloneze F-16. „Fără plan de zbor și cu transponderul oprit”
lithuania.description: Forțele aeriene poloneze au interceptat din nou un avion de recunoaștere rusesc deasupra Mării Baltice, a anunțat vineri guvernul de la Varșovia, care a publicat noi detalii în legătură cu prăbușirea unei rachete rusești pe teritoriul polonez cu o zi înainte, informează agenția germană de presă DPA. Două avioane de vânătoare poloneze F-16 au fost …

lithuania.title: Turkish Airlines: Entry into Russian airspace was a one‑off weather-related decision
lithuania.description: Turkish Airlines, whose July 12 flight from Tallinn to Istanbul briefly entered Kaliningrad airspace, says the deviation was a one‑time safety‑driven exception caused by adverse weather conditions.

lithuania.title: BLOGI ⟩ 1620. sõjapäev Ukrainas: Kiievis avaldati taas meelt ekskaitseminister Fedorovi ametisse ennistamise toetuseks
lithuania.description: 2022. aasta 24. veebruaril alustas Venemaa režiimi juht Vladimir Putin sissetungi Ukrainasse. Pärast seda, kui Ukraina lõi tagasi pealetungi Kiievile, on lahingute kese kandunud Ida- ja Lõuna-Ukrainasse. Postimees kajastab 1620. sõjapäeva sündmusi allolevas blogis.

lithuania.title: Kiievis avaldati taas meelt ekskaitseminister Fedorovi ametisse ennistamise toetuseks
lithuania.description: Tuhanded inimesed avaldasid eile Ukraina pealinnas Kiievis meelt, et nõuda kaks nädalat tagasi tagandatud noore ja tehnikateadliku kaitseministri Mõhhailo Fedorovi ametisse ennistamist.

lithuania.title: NÄDALA NÄGU ⟩ Omakasupüüdlik rahutuvi Putini kõrva ääres
lithuania.description: Kasahstani presidendi Kassõm-Džomart Tokajevi Vene režiimi juhile Vladimir Putinile silmast silma esitatud üleskutset peatada võitlus Ukrainas on küll tõlgendatud kui Kremli liitlase üllatavat kriitikat, kuid nii mõnedki piirkonda hästi tundvad analüütikud on seadnud kahtluse alla mõtteavalduse spontaansuse.

lithuania.title: International drone defence exercise to take place in Latvia
lithuania.description: From August 3rd to 14th, the military exercise “Baltic Trust 26” (BATT26), jointly organized by the Latvian National Armed Forces (NBS) and the NATO Communications and Information Agency, will be held at Sēlija military range in southern Latvia.

lithuania.title: Sārts sounds warning on potential election disruption efforts
lithuania.description: Jānis Sārts, the director of the Rīga-based NATO Strategic Communications Centre of Excellence (STRATCOMCOE) said in an interview with Latvian Radio on July 31st that Latvia's upcoming parliamentary elections could face various challenges and attempts to influence and disrupt them, with threats including drone incursions, cyberattacks and the use of malicious Artificial Intelligence (AI).

lithuania.title: Any Russian 'little green men' will be neutralised, says Latvian Defence Minister
lithuania.description: Currently, a direct military, conventional Russian attack on NATO is not possible, and stating this is not just an attempt to calm public fears of conflict, Latvian Defence Minister Raivis Melnis said in an interview with the LETA newswire.

lithuania.title: Pēc incidenta Polijā Slaidiņš pieļauj scenāriju, kas satrauc NATO
lithuania.description: Krievijas īstenotās kārtējās masīvās apšaudes laikā pret Ukrainu satraukums šoreiz valdīja ne tikai kara plosītajā valstī, bet arī Polijā. Pēc sākotnējās informācijas viena no spārnotajām raķetēm, iespējams, šķērsojusi Ukrainas rietumu robežu un nokritusi Polijas teritorijā. TV24 raidījumā “Aktuālais par karadarbību Ukrainā” NBS majors un Zemessardzes štāba virsnieks Jānis Slaidiņš norādīja, ka pagaidām ir pāragri izdarīt […]

lithuania.title: Slaidiņš: Putina plāns Ukrainā izraisījis sekas, ko Kremlis nebija gaidījis
lithuania.description: Nacionālo bruņoto spēku majors, Zemessardzes štāba virsnieks Jānis Slaidiņš TV24 raidījumā “Aktuālais par karadarbību Ukrainā” pauda, ka Krievijas politiskās elites publiskie paziņojumi liecina par apņēmību turpināt karu Ukrainā. Slaidiņš norādīja, ka pirms Valsts domes vasaras pārtraukuma tās priekšsēdētājs Vjačeslavs Volodins noslēdzošajā sēdē paziņojis, ka Krievija un tās prezidents Vladimirs Putins uzvar. Pēc NBS majora domām, […]

lithuania.title: Savaitgalio orai: vienur karščiai, kitur – liūtys su perkūnija ir galima kruša
lithuania.description: Šeštadienio dieną mūsų šalies orus lems žemesnio slėgio laukas. Dangumi plauks tai tankesni, tai retesni debesys, protarpiais džiugins saulės spinduliai. Per daugelį rajonų slinks trumpalaikiai lietūs, didesnėje šalies dalyje griaudės perkūnija.

lithuania.title: JAV sankcijų paketas Rusijai: įžvelgė dvi itin reikšmingas problemas
lithuania.description: Naujų sankcijų Rusijai įstatymo projekte, kurį šią savaitę patvirtino JAV Senatas, numatyta nemažai griežtų priemonių, tačiau jis turi ir dvi reikšmingas problemas, savo komentare „The Washington Post“ rašo apžvalgininkas Maxas Bootas.

lithuania.title: Rusija griebėsi staigaus gelbėjimosi plano – pasitelkė Maroką
lithuania.description: Rusija gavo jūriniu keliu atgabentą apie 30 000 tonų marokietiško AI-92 markės benzino siuntą, pranešė „Reuters“ du šaltiniai iš šios pramonės srities.

lithuania.title: NATO diskutuoja apie branduolinių ginklų dislokavimą Lietuvoje, Suomijoje arba Lenkijoje
lithuania.description: NATO diskutuoja apie galimybę Europoje dislokuoti papildomų JAV branduolinių ginklų, praneša „Süddeutsche Zeitung“.

lithuania.title: Lietuva įteikė protesto notą Rusijai dėl smūgių Ukrainai ir Lenkijos oro erdvės pažeidimo
lithuania.description: Į Užsienio reikalų ministeriją (URM) penktadienį iškviestam Rusijos ambasados atstovui įteikta griežto protesto nota dėl tebesitęsiančių smūgių Ukrainos civiliams ir Lenkijos oro erdvės pažeidimo.

lithuania.title: Lenkijos teismas sušvelnino kardomąją priemonę kaltinamajam Leonido Volkovo užpuolimo organizavimu
lithuania.description: Varšuvos apygardos teismas sušvelnino kardomąją priemonę kaltinamajam Lietuvoje įvykdyto išpuolio prieš Rusijos opozicijos politiką Leonidą Volkovą organizavimu, iš teismo salės penktadienį pranešė Lenkijos visuomeninio transliuotojo TVP informacinio ir publicistinio projekto rusų kalba „Vot Tak“ žurnalistas.

lithuania.title: Meloni patvirtino „ypatingąją“ priemonę – atkurti pasienio kontrolę su Ispanija
lithuania.description: Italijos ministrė pirmininkė Giorgia Meloni patvirtino sprendimą sustabdyti laisvą judėjimą per oro ir jūrų sienas su Ispanija.

lithuania.title: Seuta krito: nelegalūs migrantai plėšikauja, veržiasi į butus ir priekabiauja prie moterų
lithuania.description: Ispanijos mieste Seutoje smarkiai paaštrėjo migrantų krizė po to, kai iš Maroko jūra masiškai atvyko tūkstančiai imigrantų. „EL ESPAÑOL“ praneša, kad dėl perpildytų oficialių apgyvendinimo centrų mieste dalis dokumentų neturinčių migrantų pradėjo savavališkai užimti tuščius gyvenamuosius pastatus.

lithuania.title: Joniškyje prasiautė škvalas su žaibais: kilo vėjas, krito kruša
lithuania.description: „Facebook“ grupėje Orų entuziastai vartotojai dalijasi penktadienio vakaro vaizdais iš Joniškio.

lithuania.title: Donaldas Trumpas: Izraelis labai džiaugiasi susitarimu dėl „Hamas“ nusiginklavimo
lithuania.description: JAV prezidentas Donaldas Trumpas penktadienį pareiškė, kad Izraelis „labai džiaugiasi“ susitarimu, pagal kurį palestiniečių kovotojų grupuotė „Hamas“ perduos savo ginklus, o Izraelio pajėgos palaipsniui pasitrauks iš Gazos Ruožo.

lithuania.title: Kyjivo dilema Vašingtone – kas po Lindsey Grahamo mirties užtars Ukrainą prieš Trumpą?
lithuania.description: Respublikonų senatorius Lindsey Grahamas buvo vienas iš aktyviausių JAV karinės jėgos panaudojimo šalininkų Vašingtone, tvirtas Izraelio rėmėjas ir politikas, kuris anksčiau griežtai kritikavo Donaldą Trumpą, bet vėliau tapo vienu iš jo artimiausių sąjungininkų. Svarbiausias L.Grahamo palikimas Ukrainai gali būti jo gebėjimas užmegzti ryšį su D.Trumpu tuo metu, kai JAV prezidento santykiai su Volodymyru Zelenskiu atrodė beveik nepataisomai sugadinti. Dabar Vašingtone kyla klausimas – kas gins Ukrainos interesus prieš D.Trumpą?
